antigravity-guide.name: antigravity-guide
antigravity-guide.description: Provides a comprehensive guide, quick reference, and sitemap for Google Antigravity (AGY), including the Antigravity CLI (agy), Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, Python SDK, slash commands, keybindings, and customizations (skills, rules, MCP, sidecars). Activate this skill when the user asks questions about how to use, configure, or customize Antigravity, AGY, the agy CLI, the Antigravity IDE, or Antigravity 2.0.

Spins up competing AI solutions, runs distinct reasoning strategy cards, conducts pairwise adversarial critiques and evidence-based defense, scores matches using an explicit weighted rubric, and selects the strongest solution in Google Antigravity.
